About Us

Perth's High-End
Carpentry Specialists

At Fixing Carpentry WA, we focus on all aspects of carpentry with a deep specialisation in high-end second fixing and detailed finishing works. Every project is approached with precision, craftsmanship, and an uncompromising eye for detail.

From rich timber lining board ceilings and striking feature cladding to custom-built joinery and premium composite decking — we consistently deliver results that elevate every space.

What We Do

Our Specialisations

Premium carpentry solutions across residential and commercial projects throughout WA

01

Timber Ceilings & Lining

Stunning lining board ceilings crafted from premium timber species. Immaculate installations with beautiful grain selection, tight jointing, and flawless finish for alfresco and interior spaces alike.

02

Cladding & Feature Walls

Architectural cladding that transforms exteriors and creates bold feature walls. From vertical batten screens to horizontal lining boards — complex angles and bespoke profiles handled with precision.

03

Composite Decking

Premium composite decking installations combining beauty with durability. Perfect for pool surrounds, alfresco areas, and entertainment spaces — including curved and complex layouts.

04

Second Fixing & Joinery

Expert second fixing including architraves, skirting boards, door hanging, built-in joinery, and all detailed interior trim work. We handle high-spec residential builds with exacting standards.

05

Feature Panelling

Bespoke wall panelling systems including ribbed profiles, shiplap, and custom designs with integrated LED lighting. We create architectural moments that define the character of a space.

06

Doors & Hardware

Precise hanging of internal and external doors with premium hardware installation. From standard residential doors to oversized pivot entries and custom feature doors.
